primitives.name: Voting Rights Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: 288 WALTER CAMP'S BOOK OF COLLEGE SPORTS allowed to attend the meetings of this committee and join in debate, without power to vote.
primitives.assumptions: Participants may have access to debate but not to cast votes; symmetric representation across institutions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When non-voting participants exceed voting quorum, leading to procedural deadlock.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a weighted voting system where certain members hold zero weight in decision-making.
layer2.telemetry: Observable participation metrics in committee meetings

primitives.name: Vacancy Filling Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: Vacancies shall be filled by the other representatives of Yale University.
primitives.assumptions: Internal succession ensures continuity of representation; no external appointment allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when internal consensus cannot be reached or when representative pool is exhausted.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of recursive governance structure ensuring institutional self-regulation.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking of vacancy resolution times and internal agreement rates
